summary: NetClass Technology Inc furnished a Form -K on October 30, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing that its multi-agent AI foreign-language teaching case study received an Outstanding Case Award at the 2026 Digital Lifelong Learning International Conference, held October 16-17 at Shanghai Open University and co-organized with UNESCO UIL and IITE. No securities transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic appears; the disclosure is ordinary corporate publicity covering product recognition and platform scale (nearly 100 institutions, 40,000-plus students). No deal terms apply; no risk-arb angle exists, as the item carries no transactional or capital-structure consequence.
